title: Top Two Star Exporters in the Southern region (Gold) Award
h: H1:Top Two Star Exporters in the Southern region (Gold) Award
body:
Top Two Star Exporters in the Southern region (Gold) Award
Tuesday, January 23, 2018
The Federation of Indian Exports Organisation’s ‘Top Two Star Exporters in the Southern region (Gold) Award’, was presented by the Vice President of India Shri M Venkaiah Naidu , in the presence of the Governor of Tamil Nadu Shri Banwarilal Purohit to Eastern Condiments Pvt. Ltd. The award was received by Ms. Saramma Biju (Senior Export Manager, Eastern), Ms. Shivapriya Balagopal (Head of New Product Development, Eastern) and Mr. Abdul Salam (Production Manager, Eastern) in a ceremony held at Chennai

title: Largest Spice Exporter Award For The 18th Time In a Row

The Spices Board of India annual awards for the Top Most Exporter of Curry Powder/Spice Mix for the year 2014-15 have been awarded to Eastern Condiments Pvt. Ltd. title: Successfully cleared the TPM Certification Assessment
h: H1:Successfully cleared the TPM Certification Assessment
body:
Successfully cleared the TPM Certification Assessment
Wednesday, September 26, 2018
The Eastern Group has successfully cleared the TPM Certification Assessment. The Exhaust and Tube Mill Division (Certificate ofCommitment), which is first in Indian Condiments Industry, was received by Mr Adarsh Achuthan on behalf of the Eastern group, in an Award ceremony held on 20th September 2018.

title: Expansion of Trade
body:
Expansion of Trade
Tuesday, January 10, 2017
With the debut of Mr. Navas Meeran into the Eastern chain of business, the company steadily expanded its ventures out side Kerala. And to match the rising demands, Mr. Meeran set up a new factory in Theni, in the adjacent state of Tamil Nadu.
The very same year, Eastern set up its export facility, which today reaches consumers in 15 countries worldwide. And today Eastern is the proud and undisputed – 17 time – recipient of the ‘Largest exporter of spice masala in consumer packs’ from the ,Spices Board Of India’.
